_about: Inputs for the simulated-traffic model. Every number says where it comes from: 'source' = published figure, 'estimate' = our assumption (to be checked against live data in well-covered regions). Edit freely.

globalAirborne._note: Commercial (IFR) aircraft airborne worldwide at one moment. The model's overall size is calibrated so its peak matches 'julyPeak'; 'novemberTrough' is used to check the result.

dailyFlights2025.source: IATA via BusinessStats: 38.9 million airline flights in 2025

monthly._note: Traffic relative to the region's yearly average, Jan..Dec.

europe.basis: source: Europe ~34,200 flights/day late July vs ~25,100 early December (ratio 1.36); monthly shape estimated

china.basis: source: summer peak ~7% above average (CAAC 2024); Spring Festival (Jan/Feb) and Golden Week (Oct) estimated

middleEast.basis: estimate (summer travel; Hajj/Ramadan move each year)

southernHemisphere.basis: estimate (summer holidays Dec/Jan, winter holidays Jul)

weekday.basis: estimate (Friday busiest, Saturday quietest: common airline pattern)

departureProfiles._note: Relative departures by LOCAL hour (0..23) at the departure airport. Estimates, tuned so the global curve matches Eurocontrol's peak (~14,900, July ~14:15 UTC) and low (~7,560, November Sunday ~04:45 UTC).

banks._note: Typical long-haul timing by direction (local departure hours). Overrides 'longHaul' for these flows. Windows are [from, to] or [from, to, weight] (weight 1 if left out; hours past 24 wrap to the next morning); 'floor' is the weight of every other hour (default 0.05; higher where freighters and scattered flights run around the clock). Estimates based on well-known airline scheduling patterns.

asiaToNorthAmerica.basis: strong mid-afternoon to early-evening wave (Tokyo/Seoul/Taipei departures ~15:00-20:00 local, arriving on the US west coast in the morning), later departures from Hong Kong/China/Manila, daytime departures from Seoul/Shanghai, a few after midnight; freighters at all hours

northAmericaToAsia.basis: midday departures (US airlines, ANA/JAL) plus the late-night wave of Asian carriers from LAX/SFO/YVR (~22:00-01:30); freighters at all hours

asiaToEurope.basis: late-night departures arriving in Europe early morning

_sources: Eurocontrol Data Snapshot: how many aircraft are in the air at a given moment? (https://www.atc-network.com/atc-news/eurocontrol/eurocontrol-data-snapshot-how-many-aircraft-are-in-the-air-at-a-given-moment)
Lazarski Aviation Academy: Seasonality in air traffic (https://aviation.lazarski.pl/seasonality-in-air-traffic/)
BusinessStats: global air traffic, number of flights (https://businesstats.com/global-air-traffic-number-of-flights/)
CAAC: China Civil Aviation Annual Report 2024 (http://www.caac.gov.cn/English/Research/Reports/Statistical/202512/P020251202509925682656.pdf)
The Week / PTI: Indian carriers to operate 25,610 flights per week, summer 2025 (https://www.theweek.in/wire-updates/business/2025/03/25/del106-avi-dgca-flights.html)

regionalDailyFlights._note: Average daily departures per region. The calibration (scripts/sim/calibrate.ts) adjusts each region so its share of global flights matches these; other countries keep the route network's own proportions.

us.basis: source: FlightAware 2024 US commercial flights, 26,656-29,109/day by season

europe.basis: source: Eurocontrol network 10,690,602 flights in 2024 (/366 days)

world.basis: source: IATA via BusinessStats, 38.9 million flights in 2025

corridorDailyFlights._note: Average daily flights (both directions) on long ocean corridors. The calibration scales the routes in each corridor so its share of global flights matches. Corridors: see corridorOf() in src/sim/schedule.ts. (The Pacific is set by country pair below, plus freighters in cargo-routes.json.)

europeNorthAmerica.basis: source: 580,487 flights between Europe and North America in 2023 (ForeFlight, 'Transatlantic Flight Operations'), /365

hawaiiMainland.basis: source: Hawaii Tourism Authority air service grid, July 2024 schedules: 4,382 (US West) + 389 (US East) flights/month into Hawaii, x2 directions /31 = ~308; rounded down for the yearly average

pairDailyFlights._note: Average daily passenger flights (both directions) between two countries, for pairs where the 2014 route data is far from today (e.g. China-US flights were cut sharply after 2020). Keys are ISO country codes in alphabetical order. Estimates from 2024-25 airline schedules (rounded); edit freely, then run npm run sim:calibrate. Pacific pairs include ~25% on top of airline schedules for charters, business jets and military flights that live trackers also show (tuned against a live-tracker view of the North Pacific).

JP-US.basis: estimate: US mainland-Japan ~130 (United, Delta, American, ANA, JAL, ZIPAIR, Hawaiian) + Hawaii-Japan ~60

CN-US.basis: estimate: ~100 round trips/week under the 2025 US-China caps, plus charters

KR-US.basis: estimate: Korean Air, Asiana, Delta, United, Air Premia

TW-US.basis: estimate: EVA Air, China Airlines, Starlux, United, Delta

NZ-US.basis: estimate: Air New Zealand, United, American, Delta

CA-CN.basis: estimate: Air China, China Eastern, China Southern, Air Canada

CA-TW.basis: estimate: EVA Air, China Airlines, Air Canada
